description: Trace one cross-chain transfer from its SOURCE transaction on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum or OP Mainnet (every bridge below), or, CCTP only, 20 more EVM networks (HyperEVM, Polygon, Avalanche …); the bridge is detected from the transaction’s own logs (`bridge`: cctp, across, layerzero, wormhole, or multiple) and `network` may be left out (the four are asked). CIRCLE CCTP V2 (USDC; from the stored index when it holds the transaction completed, else read now): for every CCTP message (keyed by its CCTP nonce, or its source log before Circle assigns one) the burn, messageSender, mintRecipient, destination domain (CCTP domains, not chain ids), Circle’s attestation from Iris v2, the destination MessageReceived and mint checked against the nonce, fee executed, timings, status (source_observed, attested, destination_pending, completed, unknown), and `subsequent`: deposits by the mint recipient into vaults we track within `hours` after the mint, each labelled a possible subsequent deposit, not proven same coins. ACROSS V3, LAYERZERO OFT / STARGATE V2, WORMHOLE TOKEN BRIDGE + NTT (any token, on demand, nothing stored): every transfer keyed by the link its protocol defines (Across originChainId + depositId, LayerZero guid, Wormhole emitter chain/emitter/sequence, NTT digest), token by chain + contract, amount and USD at the source block (DefiLlama; unpriced stays null), sender, recipient, destination chain, the destination event (FilledRelay, OFTReceived, TransferRedeemed) found on chain — the Across, LayerZero Scan and Wormholescan APIs are hints only, each verified on chain — delivered amount, relayer, checks, fee, timings and a status: completed, destination_pending (not found in the window read: pending, never lost), expired or refunded (Across), source_observed (destination outside the four, or unread). Volume counts the source once. Never claims the addresses share an owner, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. bridge_coverage says what is and is not covered. FREE.

hours.description: CCTP only: window after the mint for possible subsequent deposits: default 72, at most 168.

network.description: Optional: the SOURCE network (optimism = OP Mainnet; beyond base, ethereum, arbitrum and optimism CCTP only). Left out, those four are asked for the transaction.

tx.description: The source transaction hash (0x + 64 hex): the burn, deposit or send.

name: cross_chain_trace

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

bridge.description: cctp | across | layerzero | wormhole | multiple; null when the transaction carries no transfer of these.

coverage.description: The coverage of the path that answered, as bridge_coverage states it.

detected.description: Every bridge whose source event the transaction carries.

index.description: The stored index: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), readAt, says.

messages.description: CCTP: one entry per CCTP V2 message (key, keyKind, kind, status, statusSays, source, burn, messageSender, mintRecipient, messageRecipient, destinationCaller, destinationDomain, destinationNetwork, inScope, attestation, feeExecuted, expirationBlock, destination, timings, subsequent). Across / LayerZero / Wormhole: one entry per transfer (key, keyKind, bridge, version, linkId, status, tableStatus, statusSays, source, token, amount, usd, sender, recipient, refundAddress, destinationChain, inScope, hint, destination with state, evidence, tx, token, amount, usd, relayer, window and checks, fees, timings, details). Empty when the transaction carries none.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

notClaimed.description: What this trace never establishes: same owner, an AI agent, autonomy, same coins.

protocol.description: Circle CCTP V2, or the bridge versions found (Across V3, LayerZero OFT, Stargate V2, Wormhole Token Bridge (Portal), Wormhole NTT), or none detected.

says.description: One sentence on what was found.

servedFrom.description: Since 2026-11-24: index when every message of the transaction is held in the stored index and completed; on_demand when it was read now.

sourceReceipt.description: What the source chain said about the transaction; unread is no provider answered, never absent.

volume.description: CCTP: USDC burned, counted once per transfer (amount native, decimals, amountFormatted). Other bridges: usd at the source, pricedTransfers, unpricedTransfers. The destination leg is a phase of the same transfer, never added.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Cross-chain trace (CCTP, Across, LayerZero, Wormhole)
